rows.ja: 合弁・出資パートナー

companies.name: シェブロン・フィリップス・ケミカル

relations.text: 石油化学の合弁会社に50%出資
relations.text_en: Holds 50% of the petrochemicals joint venture

source.label: Phillips 66 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Chemicals segment consists of our 50% equity investment in Chevron Phillips Chemical Company LLC (CPChem).

relations.text: CPChemの共同出資者。支配権変更時の買取権を持つ
relations.text_en: CPChem co-owner with a buyout right on change of control

source.label: Phillips 66 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For example, Phillips 66's agreement with Chevron Corporation (Chevron) regarding CPChem permits Chevron to buy Phillips 66's 50% interest in CPChem for fair market value if Phillips 66 experiences a change in control or if both Standard & Poor's Financial Services LLC and Moody's Investors Service, Inc. lower their credit ratings below investment grade and the credit rating from either rating agency remains below investment grade for 365 days thereafter, with fair market value determined by agreement or by nationally recognized investment banks.

relations.text: DCPミッドストリームを50%ずつ共同保有していた

source.label: Phillips 66 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Prior to the DCP Midstream Merger, we and Enbridge each held a 50 % interest and jointly governed DCP Midstream, whose primary assets are its general partner and limited partner interests in DCP Midstream, LP (DCP LP), and we each held indirect economic interests in DCP LP of 28.26 %.

companies.name: エナジー・トランスファー

relations.text: 原油パイプライン「バイユー・ブリッジ」の合弁相手
relations.text_en: Partner in the Bayou Bridge crude pipeline JV

source.label: Energy Transfer 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Bayou Bridge Pipeline is a joint venture between Energy Transfer and a subsidiary of Phillips 66, in which we have a 60% ownership interest and serve as the operator of the pipeline.

relations.text: 製油所合弁WRBの残り50%をセノバスから取得
relations.text_en: Bought Cenovus's remaining 50% of the WRB refining JV

source.label: Phillips 66 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On October 1, 2025, we acquired the remaining 50% equity interest in WRB Refining LP (WRB), a joint venture that owned the Wood River and Borger refineries, from subsidiaries of Cenovus Energy Inc. (Cenovus).

companies.name: コープ・ミネラルエール

relations.text: スイスの燃料販売合弁の49%を売却
relations.text_en: Sold its 49% of the Swiss fuel-marketing JV

source.label: Phillips 66 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On January 31, 2025, we sold our 49% ownership interest in Coop Mineraloel AG, a joint venture that markets refined petroleum products in Switzerland.
